purpose: Exact finite-claim certificate digital twin, not Millennium theorem certification

claims.statement: Exact rational evaluation of the finite harmonic sum H_16 = sum(k=1..16, 1/k).
claims.limitations: This finite rational calculation says nothing about every nontrivial zeta zero or the Li-criterion for all indices.

claims.statement: The fixed odd-charge K4 Tseitin 3-CNF has no satisfying Boolean assignment.
claims.limitations: One finite resolution refutation cannot establish P=NP or P!=NP.

claims.statement: For nu=1, K=3 and q in {1,1/2,1/4,1/8}, the finite rational values 2K(1-q)/nu equal the supplied samples.
claims.limitations: These sample equalities do not prove the conditional PDE energy inequality or general global regularity.

claims.statement: For n=1..8, the positive rational transfer matrices [[1,q],[q,1]] with q=2^-n have the reported exact subleading-to-leading eigenvalue ratios.
claims.limitations: This finite two-state model is not a four-dimensional quantum Yang-Mills theory or a physical mass-gap theorem.

claims.statement: Within the explicitly presented rational quotient algebra Q[h]/(h^5), h^5=0 and the h^4 coefficients of h^k h^(4-k) are 1 for k=0..4.
claims.limitations: Algebra inside this prescribed quotient does not prove it models arbitrary rational Hodge classes.

claims.statement: For the fixed elliptic curve y^2=x^3-x, the reported point counts over eight specified prime fields include one point at infinity.
claims.limitations: Finite-field local point counts do not imply analytic rank, algebraic rank or finiteness of Sha.

claims.statement: The simplicial mod-2 chain complex of the boundary of the four-simplex on five vertices has boundary ranks (4,6,4) and Betti numbers (1,0,0,1).
claims.limitations: Finite homology of a known complex is not an independent reconstruction of Perelman's solved theorem.
